# Content Collectiv

> AI-powered inbound marketing engine plus social planner for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Content Collectiv helps founders and marketers build a complete inbound marketing system — brand voice, strategy, content, funnels and analytics — and then schedule that content natively to LinkedIn (personal + company), Facebook Business Pages and Instagram Business.

## Pages

- [Inbound Engine](/engine): Brand Voice, Strategy, Content, Funnel and Analytics modules powered by Gemini 3 Flash. One-off £49 unlock.
- [Social Planner](/scheduler): Plan and auto-post to LinkedIn, Facebook Pages and Instagram. £6.99/month subscription.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account sign-in and sign-up.
